messages:
maya: Hey team — can someone share the regional models summary panel? I need to pull per-region latency + model health numbers for an async update. Tried the grafana link from the docs but I get a 403/Not found.

liam: Which grafana org/role do you have? dashboards sometimes hide based on SSO groups.

maya: I'm in Eng-ML and SRE groups, should have 'model-observability' access. Not sure why it's blocked for me.

ops-bot: Shortlink created: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/xyz123/models-region-summary (expires in 30d) — try that.

maya: Tried the shortlink, still 403. It shows "You don't have permission to view this dashboard." No error details in the console.

liam: Can you run this quick check to see what Grafana thinks of your token?

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" \
  https://grafana.redwood.ai/api/dashboards/uid/xyz123 | jq -r '.meta.organization'
```
If that returns null or an org you don't expect, you're missing the view group.

sara: I can add you to the redwood-models-view group. Maya — what's your employee id or SSO email?

maya: maya@redwood.ai / emp-0342. Thanks Sara.

sara: Ok adding now. Give it 2-3 minutes for SSO sync.

ops-bot: Access change detected for maya@redwood.ai — group membership updated (redwood-models-view).

maya: Confirmed — shortlink now loads for me :tada: Panel looks good, shows per-region p50/p95 and model health flags.

maya: Quick follow-up: can we pin this panel to the Eng-ML sidebar in Grafana or add the shortlink to the team README? We'll be hitting this often for post-deploy checks.

liam: +1. I'll create a tiny ticket and tag infra to pin it. https://boards.redwood.ai/issue/ML-1729

sara: added link to eng-ml README too.

maya: Awesome, thanks all!
